title: Verify Dashboard URL
description: Verifies that a generated dashboard URL is actually usable: its hostname resolves, and both the deep-linked page and /api/health on that host return 200 across repeated probes while a scan is running. Fails with an UNRESOLVABLE, DOWN (connection refused), or UNRESPONSIVE (accepts connections but stalls) url_status and a remediation hint instead of handing out a dead link. Succeeds with VERIFIED (every probe passed) or DEGRADED (final round passed, a minority of probes were slow -- report with a latency caveat).
